children: According to Wallstreetcn, Iranian media on September 26 cited an interview with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian saying a new plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz in Tehran had been coordinated with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, and that Iran would fulfill its obligations if the United States agreed to the proposal.

title: Iran's Pezeshkian Says New Plan to Reopen the Strait of Hormuz Was Coordinated With Supreme Leader
